verdict.rationale: Concurrency keys let you create per-user queue logic (docs-27), and per-queue `concurrencyLimit` caps how many runs execute at once (docs-8). Together these give a form of tenant isolation rather than a single shared FIFO. The pack has no evidence of assigning priorities to individual runs, and no explicit description of a fair-scheduling algorithm across tenants. Missing for 10: per-run priority assignment, documented fair-scheduling semantics across tenants, independent or hands-on corroboration.
